text:
A pure substance is heated slowly. The temperature of the substance is measured as it starts to
melt and when it finishes melting.
Which statement is correct?
A
The temperature decreases slightly as the substance melts.
B
The temperature fluctuates as the substance melts.
C
The temperature increases as the substance melts.
D
The temperature stays the same as the substance melts.

options.label: A
options.text: The temperature decreases slightly as the substance melts.

options.label: B
options.text: The temperature fluctuates as the substance melts.

options.label: C
options.text: The temperature increases as the substance melts.

options.label: D
options.text: The temperature stays the same as the substance melts.

subject: Physics
